skill.summary: Get snow conditions, forecasts, and ski reports for any mountain resort worldwide. Use when asked about snow, powder, ski conditions, or mountain weather. Supports 1000+ resorts via OpenSnow. Users can set favorite mountains for quick access. Supports SnowTick 4-letter codes (JHMR, TARG, MMTH) for quick lookups.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release - OpenSnow integration with SnowTick codes
